# Ramble

> Ramble into your Apple Watch. Your agent handles it. Tap the watch and talk; the iPhone transcribes it and passes the text to your agent, which picks it up on a schedule. No accounts.

Pairing: in Ramble on iPhone, Settings → Connect agent gives a single-use code. Tell your agent "I downloaded Ramble, connect it" and paste the code. The agent then pulls new transcripts and acknowledges them, which deletes them. Anything never picked up is deleted after 30 days. Audio never goes to the relay.

Ramble can also send each transcript to any HTTPS endpoint (webhooks).

## Docs

- [Full reference](/llms-full.txt): Agent connection, the relay API, and the webhook API.
- [Connect your agent](/docs): Pairing, the agent loop, and the relay API.
- [Webhooks](/docs/webhooks): Payload format, signature verification, retries, automation platforms.
